name: dogfood-search-opensearch-app
description: Dogfood app v1.36-4 — an OpenSearch-OSS-anchored relevance-tuning + synonym-advanced + rolling-reindex harness driven behind a provider-neutral 17-op contract backed by @kiwa-lab/search v0.3 semantics (relevance + synonym-advanced + index-management axes) + real-driver env-gate against an OpenSearch OSS cluster (testcontainers-friendly). Two adapter implementations satisfy the same contract: makeMockAdapter walks the search v0.3 relevance + synonym + index-mgmt state machines deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter models the wire surface for the OpenSearch OSS HTTP API behind the KIWA_MODE=real env-gate (KIWA_OPENSEARCH_URL + OPENSEARCH_KEY) and otherwise reports KIWA_SEARCH_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 fixture sets (articles / multilingual / cluster) x BM25 + TF-IDF + custom ranking + A/B variant + multi-language expansion + phonetic + stemmer + typo + shard allocate + replica promote + rolling reindex + zero-downtime swap so behavioural drift between mock semantics and the real OpenSearch OSS wire surface stays observable and feeds the @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/build-deps.mjs @kiwa-lab/search @kiwa-lab/core @kiwa-lab/quality-metrics && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
